name: Conversations at the AquaBar
source:
What you thought was going to be a good day at a gaming, PowerSuit and Mecha convention turns out to be a terrible experience. Unwind at the AquaBar with a stranger, talk about your day, and you might realize that you have seen this person before.

[From [url=https://rainspicestudios.itch.io/conversationsattheaquabar]itch.io[/url]]
